limitations: Only three independent original PDFs plus one derived raster PDF; 8/16 tabs repeat these under distinct paths.
Active-ready means the last selected restored tab is ready/responding after all entries opened, not first-paint timing.
Background means system busy CPU minus target process; includes controller and OS services. This is monitoring/gating, not process isolation, affinity or CPU frequency control.
Each accepted count has three before-first pairs and one after-first pair after exclusions; the attempted order alternated but accepted order is unbalanced.
Private Bytes are sampled every requested 20ms and can miss short peaks. OS peak working set is cumulative from fresh process startup.
Near-adjacent raw CPU snapshots sometimes backstep; used 200ms windows were audited for positive total/idle deltas. No failing used window was accepted.
Six 16-tab pairs are retained only as excluded performance attempts; their 96 image pairs still verify rendering in those attempts.
Tab group definitions are generated from the settings schema; loading uses the real Restore UI. Save UI had earlier two-document coverage.
Read/load and thumbnail engine clones are included in the real restoration workload.
No commit/push or portable replacement performed.
